rationale: The closest supported evidence is the dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; experiment batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2), which adds an actions/cache step for ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml. This workflow already satisfies that optimization: the test job uses astral-sh/setup-uv@v7 with enable-cache: true and cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock", so dependency downloads are already cached. Because uv uses its own cache rather than ~/.cache/pip, adding a separate pip cache would be unused/redundant, and the pattern's contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies. Other candidate patterns are not suitable: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because the coverage job needs coverage artifacts from every matrix config (every matrix outcome is required); P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow includes release/deployment work (PyPI publish); P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative duration history for a safe limit. No supported change preserves build/test coverage without violating a contraindication.
